method: Published npm tarball openclaw@2026.10.3 read (docs/, dist/*.d.ts, dist/*.mjs) and installed natively (npm install openclaw@2026.10.3; `openclaw --version` -> OpenClaw 2026.10.3 (59cb447)). Shape-level only: CI does not run a gateway. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-openclaw-wisdom-parity-leg-design.md (facts F1-F15).
middlewareThrowReplacesResult: a throwing or invalid middleware result is replaced by 'Tool output unavailable due to post-processing error.' (tool-result-middleware applyToolResultMiddleware); verified 2026-10-17
modelCallIdFormat: <runId>:model:<n>, one per model call (live 2026-10-17; attempt.model-diagnostic-events modelCallHookEventBase, dispatched fire-and-forget)
beforeToolCallPrecedesApproval: before_tool_call handlers run before requireApproval is resolved and before exec approvals; a throwing or timed-out handler blocks the tool (agent-tools.before-tool-call runBeforeToolCallHook; docs/plugins/hooks/reference.md); verified 2026-10-17
middlewareRewritePersisted: A3, live 2026-10-17: an appended middleware text block is in the next model request, in transcript_events, replayed byte-identically in a fresh process, and in the next before_prompt_build event.messages

modelPromptProjection.note: embedded runner composes [prependContext, prompt, appendContext] into the user turn's projection, captured once per admission and replayed for historical user messages (builtin-openclaw installModelPromptProjection / projectRecordedModelPrompt); prompt-hook snapshots strip only __openclaw.upstreamUserText (model-context-message projectModelContextMessages)
